newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brewer DB says to rationalise beer canning.
newsitem.headline: Brewer DB says to rationalise beer canning.

text.p: New Zealand brewer DB Group said on Tuesday it would rationalise its beer canning activities into a single plant in Auckland and in the process shut down two other breweries' canning operations.
In a statement the company said the decision followed a review of manufacturing options across its breweries and an analysis of likely future consumption levels.
"We regret having to take this action, the continuing decline in beer consumption has made rationalisation inevitable," the statement said.

Chief executive Brian Blake said the move should help increase utilisation at all three of its sites "thereby ensuring the continued profitability of DB Breweries at an acceptable level to our shareholders".
This in turn will safeguard the jobs of DB's hundreds of employees.
